cards.title: Accept-time states
items: Received, Rejected and Skipped are decided inside the API call
Rejected: invalid request, unknown template, bad recipient, missing parameter (400) or full queue (503)
Skipped: unsupported or unconfigured channel, no template version, unknown Teams destination

cards.title: Delivery-time states
items: Queued, Delivering, Retry Waiting, Delivered and Failed happen after the 200
At most 3 attempts; waits of 5 s then 30 s between them, each wait a message back in the queue
The caller reads 3 public statuses with GET /v1/notifications/{id}: pending (Queued, Delivering, Retry Waiting), success (Delivered) and failed (Failed, Skipped)

cards.title: Kept in Redis
items: Queued and Retry Waiting are messages in the Redis delivery list: a deploy loses none, and a hard crash can lose the 1 message a replica holds
The status record is kept 24 h from its last write; a skipped call reads failed and the reason is never shown
Each state change is one structured log entry carrying the notification id
